name: Daytona Sandbox
description: OpenClaw sandbox backend that runs agent exec and file tools inside Daytona cloud sandboxes over the Daytona toolbox API.

apiKey.label: Daytona API Key
apiKey.help: Daytona API key or SecretRef (fallback: DAYTONA_API_KEY env var).

apiUrl.label: Daytona API URL
apiUrl.help: Optional Daytona API base URL (fallback: DAYTONA_API_URL env var). Defaults to Daytona cloud.

target.label: Target Region
target.help: Optional Daytona target region for new sandboxes (fallback: DAYTONA_TARGET env var).

snapshot.label: Snapshot
snapshot.help: Daytona snapshot for new sandboxes. Defaults to the Daytona default snapshot. The image needs sh, tar, base64, stat, and python3 on PATH. Mutually exclusive with image.

image.label: Image
image.help: Docker image for new sandboxes, pulled or built by Daytona on first create. Mutually exclusive with snapshot.

resources.label: Resources
resources.help: CPU, GPU, memory (GiB), and disk (GiB) for image-based sandboxes. Omitted fields use the Daytona defaults. Snapshot sandboxes size from the snapshot.

user.label: OS User
user.help: OS user for the sandbox. When set, align remoteWorkspaceDir and remoteAgentWorkspaceDir with that user's writable paths.

volumes.label: Volumes
volumes.help: Daytona volumes to mount, as { volumeId, mountPath } entries. Volume paths are reachable from exec commands but stay outside the file-tool workspace mounts.

autoStopInterval.label: Auto-stop Interval Minutes
autoStopInterval.help: Minutes of inactivity before Daytona stops the sandbox; 0 keeps it running. Defaults to the Daytona default (15). Stopped sandboxes restart on next use.

autoPauseInterval.label: Auto-pause Interval Minutes
autoPauseInterval.help: Minutes of inactivity before Daytona pauses the sandbox; 0 disables. Pause needs VM-based runners and preserves memory state. Only one of auto-stop and auto-pause may be non-zero.

autoArchiveInterval.label: Auto-archive Interval Minutes
autoArchiveInterval.help: Minutes a stopped sandbox waits before Daytona archives it to cold storage; 0 uses the Daytona maximum. Defaults to 7 days.

autoDeleteInterval.label: Auto-delete Interval Minutes
autoDeleteInterval.help: Minutes a sandbox may stay stopped before Daytona deletes it; 0 deletes immediately on stop. Disabled by default.

networkBlockAll.label: Block Network
networkBlockAll.help: Block all sandbox network egress. Enabled by default, matching the Docker backend's no-network default; set false for open egress.

networkAllowList.label: Network Allow List
networkAllowList.help: Comma-separated CIDR addresses the sandbox may reach. Setting this with Block Network unset enables selective egress.

domainAllowList.label: Domain Allow List
domainAllowList.help: Comma-separated domains the sandbox may reach. Setting this with Block Network unset enables selective egress.

remoteWorkspaceDir.label: Remote Workspace Dir
remoteWorkspaceDir.help: Absolute path of the writable session workspace inside the Daytona sandbox.

remoteAgentWorkspaceDir.label: Remote Agent Dir
remoteAgentWorkspaceDir.help: Absolute path mirroring the real agent workspace when workspaceAccess is not none.

timeoutSeconds.label: API Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for Daytona API operations such as create, upload, and filesystem commands.
